description: This Java source file defines the BugreportParser class, responsible for parsing Android bugreport text files. It includes logic for detecting and parsing various sections of the bugreport such as system logs, event logs, and VM traces, and organizes the parsing workflow with section parsers.

classes.name: BugreportParser
classes.description: Main class for parsing Android bugreport text files. Handles reading sections, invoking section-specific parsers, and assembling the parsed data into a Bugreport object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the input lines into a Bugreport object, identifying sections and processing them.

methods.name: parseSection
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a specific section to the appropriate SectionParser.
